label: CREATURE split into two typed senses; caused-esse-is-received derived through the Fourth-Way maximum
summary: Follow-up (1) of attempt 170d6a5e (#1494). SENSE SPLIT: disambiguation c49de1e9 (term CREATURE) with CREATURE_1 = DEF-CREATURE (q.13 a.5: ordered to God as principle and cause), typed as IsCreatureOfUniversalCause (some g other than x causes the being of every other being in act, CausesAllInGenus at esse, and causes x's being; God read by the Fourth-Way description 'causa esse omnibus entibus ... et hoc dicimus Deum'; uniqueness not built in), and CREATURE_2 = new definition fdfbbc59, typed as IsCausedInBeingByAnother (some other being causes x's being, a secondary cause included). CREATURE_1 entails CREATURE_2 by definition; controls model 1 separates them (a being caused by another that no universal cause causes). RELABELS: 29e71e43 ('The esse of every CREATURE_1 is received in some principle'), 612078bf ('Everything other than the primary is CREATURE_1'), creatures-ordered-to-primary-as-cause and the q.13 a.5 claim label at CREATURE_1. b7d4eede was NOT relabelled as a pure CREATURE_2 statement, deliberately departing from the brief's suggestion: typed at CREATURE_2 throughout it would be analytic (caused by another implies caused by another), and in the registered Round 2 chain (OTHERS-ARE-CREATURES-FROM-PARTICIPATION, then STRICT-PRIMACY-FROM-RECEPTION-LIMITS and the Fourth-Way attribution readings) its consequent is the same Creature predicate as 612078bf and 29e71e43, which take CREATURE_1. So b7d4eede is read with antecedent CREATURE_2 and consequent CREATURE_1: it IS the sense bridge ('Whatever is CREATURE_2 (caused in being by another) is CREATURE_1'), linking both definitions, and OTHERS-ARE-CREATURES-FROM-PARTICIPATION now lists it in sense_bridges. Its earlier broad gloss of the consequent was the source of the #1494 equivocation, and the same equivocation sat unflagged in the Round 2 chain othersAreCreatures + nothingElseReachesPrimary; under the new reading both chains are sense-consistent. No frozen Challenge was edited. DERIVATIONS (specs/creature-senses.toml, all Comparator- and NanoDa-verified, zero axioms): (a) the bridge b7d4eede at CREATURE_1 (causedInBeingByAnotherIsCreature1) from the PROVED Fourth-Way consequence 0e242e29 (MaximalCauseWithNoDistinctEsseCause: some maximum in being causes the being of every other being in act and has no distinct cause of its being; result quartaViaWitness, from the four quarta via readings and the Metaphysics II.1 causal comparison d5a94eb1) and one new weak premise 2f2f5bd2 (whatever has its being caused is in act as to being), the esse-restricted weak version of 67aa5b5c (strengthens relation, verified projection; CAUSE-OF-BEING-HAS-WHAT-IT-GIVES-FROM-PREEXISTENCE now records strong_version_needed, since it applies 67aa5b5c at every respect). Proof: if c distinct from x causes x's being, x is not the maximum m (m has no distinct cause), x is in act as to being, so m causes x's being. (b) da72ae93 (causedEsseIsReceivedThroughCreature1) from b7d4eede and 29e71e43, both bound to the same typed CREATURE_1 predicate, with b7d4eede in sense_bridges. (c) Controls: model 1 (bridge fails without the Fourth-Way consequence; the senses come apart), model 2 (bridge fails without the weak premise), model 3 (the whole new bundle with 29e71e43, da72ae93 and a caused being: nonvacuity). COMPARISON WITH KEEPING da72ae93 BARE: not a mere re-split. The bare bridge said that whatever ANY other being causes in its being has received esse. The new route splits it into (i) whatever any other being causes in its being is also caused in its being by the universal cause, which now rests on universal causation of being as the Fourth Way already asserts it on the root routes (no new root premise beyond 2f2f5bd2, near-analytic under the atemporal reading of the cause of being; 0e242e29 itself newly reaches the root through this route, its own premises already did), and (ii) the esse of what the universal cause causes is received (29e71e43 at CREATURE_1, the scope q.7 a.2 speaks of: things made by God; still an open generalization from a subsistent created form to every creature, recorded as supported). SEMANTIC CHALLENGE (coordinator, accepted with minor repairs, no P1): recorded in the CREATURE disambiguation that the Creature-parametric statements b7d4eede, 29e71e43 and 612078bf are kept to CREATURE_1 by records, not by the kernel (bind-check matches head constants); recorded on 612078bf and QUARTA-VIA-ATTRIBUTION-GENUS-PRINCIPLE-AT-BEING that the premise read at CREATURE_1 carries the existence of a universal cause of being (a warrant burden, not a proof gap); recorded on b7d4eede that keeping its id across the reread is a borderline statement-identity case, acceptable because documented and nothing consumes the analytic reading. CODEX P1 (thread 4547921106), repaired: recording the parametric-Creature gap was not enough, since a sense must be fixed by its Lean declaration. The new arguments now bind sense-fixed sibling statements 5969873b (Whatever is CREATURE_2 is CREATURE_1, sense-fixed; Lean CausedInBeingByAnotherIsCreature1, naming both sense constants; the derived bridge) and ea2c4745 (The esse of every CREATURE_1 is received in some principle, sense-fixed; Lean Creature1EsseIsReceived; supported by the same q.7 claim as 29e71e43, same gap), declare term_senses CREATURE_1, and connect to the legacy statements by two transcriptions by instantiation (5969873b gives b7d4eede; 29e71e43 gives ea2c4745). Negative test (run locally, then reverted): a variant of the 29e71e43 instantiation that took 29e71e43 at IsCausedInBeingByAnother (CREATURE_2) was rejected by bind-check (other-sense-mentioned, statement-sense-not-instantiated). Legacy merged arguments (Round 2, the Fourth-Way attribution readings) still bind the Creature-parametric declarations and keep the sense by records only; their Challenges are frozen. Computed (frontier-diff against 78e5ed2e, after the repair): open premises reaching the root 464 -> 464 (bare 325 -> 324, supported 93 -> 94); b7d4eede and da72ae93 move bare -> closed (closed by verified derivations whose premises are not all established; nothing is established); 2f2f5bd2 added bare; ea2c4745 added supported (a sense-fixed duplicate of 29e71e43, which stays on the Round 2 route); three support alternatives added. OBJECTION AUDIT (substantive objection standard, both ways). (1) Weight now sits on universal causation of being (CausesAllInGenus of the Fourth-Way maximum, via its genus principle d9fad785). Objections to that principle belong to its nodes (e.g. 'BEING_1 is not a GENUS_1 in the strict sense', 24f53eb7, on d9fad785); this batch adds none and claims none answered. (2) Secondary causes: the bridge says a thing caused by a secondary cause is ALSO caused in its being by the universal cause. CausesIn is not exclusive in the vocabulary (nothing says a thing has one cause of being), so there is no overdetermination conflict to report; no substantive objection identified at the level of the formal step. (3) Existential inertia (Schmid 2021, owned by #1493's CAUSE_OF_BEING_1/2 split): it targets SUSTAINING causation of being (CAUSE_OF_BEING_2); CausesIn here is the atemporal cause of being, and the bridge uses no persistence or sustaining claim, so that mechanism does not bind this step; it binds the Fourth-Way premises only if CausesAllInGenus is read as sustaining, which this batch does not do. (4) Trinitarian scope: definition 80dea550 binds both senses and 0e242e29; read with the processions as instances, 0e242e29's 'no distinct cause of its being' and the bridge would make a divine person a creature; the stipulation excludes them, as in #1494. (5) Scotus, Ockham, Suarez (DM 31) on esse and essence: unread lead with no evidential weight; it would target 29e71e43 at CREATURE_1 (and the reception premises), not b7d4eede, and only if EsseReceivedIn requires a really distinct receiving principle; these authors accept that creatures are caused in being by God. (6) Supporting side: the derivation establishes nothing; 0e242e29 is proved but not established, 29e71e43 and 2f2f5bd2 are open, and reading q.13 a.5's 'God' as the universal cause of being is the analyst's precisification recorded in DEF-CREATURE.
blocker: Not blocked. Next tests: (0) Suarez DM 31 / Scotus on esse and essence, now aimed at the reception premises (29e71e43 and its sense-fixed sibling ea2c4745 at CREATURE_1, and 7de89edb) rather than at a general caused-esse bridge; (1) 29e71e43 still generalizes q.7 a.2 from a subsistent created form to every CREATURE_1: a material composite's esse could be read as received through its form in matter (q.7 a.1), a candidate derivation; (2) uniqueness of the universal cause is not built into CREATURE_1, and no current downstream use needs it; the spine's root uniqueness results could tie the g of CREATURE_1 to the selected root if a later argument needs it. Observation (informal, not lake-checked): combining the Round 2 premises at CREATURE_1 (29e71e43 and STMT-PRIMARY-ESSE-UNRECEIVED for the primary p) with 0e242e29 forces p = m whenever p is in act as to being: otherwise m causes p's being, p is CREATURE_1, so p's esse is received, contrary to PrimaryEsseUnreceived. Control model 3 has no primary p, so it does not witness that combination; (3) the earlier open tests (2)-(4) of attempt 170d6a5e remain.
